{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Innovation and Distress", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high R&D investment and low book leverage tend to outperform, as they are more likely to create innovative products and avoid financial distress.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Earnings Quality and Momentum", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high earnings quality and momentum tend to outperform, as they are more likely to have sustainable earnings growth.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom6m"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Financial Constraints and Investment", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high financial constraints and low investment tend to outperform, as they are more likely to have efficient capital allocation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "NetDebtFinance"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Beta", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Intangible Assets and Profitability", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high intangible assets and profitability tend to outperform, as they are more likely to have sustainable competitive advantages.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "mega", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 12},
{"name": "Liquidity and Earnings Surprise", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high liquidity and earnings surprise tend to outperform, as they are more likely to have efficient information dissemination.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Illiquidity"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsSurprise"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "MomOffSeason", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Organizational Capital and Investment", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high organizational capital and low investment tend to outperform, as they are more likely to have efficient resource allocation.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OrgCap"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Investment"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Patent Activity and R&D", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high patent activity and R&D investment tend to outperform, as they are more likely to create innovative products.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PatentsRD"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Real Estate and Leverage", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high real estate holdings and low leverage tend to outperform, as they are more likely to have stable cash flows.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "realestate"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}
]}
